Name: More space on Hill-top Farm
Author: Bladon001
Description:
Improved Hill-top Farm map with much more space for crops near the house.

Almost no new walls were added so it should be safe to install this mod also on older saves. Only few bushes may need to be deleted in save editor.
Tested on Stardew Valley 1.11.


[size=5]Installation instructions[/size]

[size=2]1. Download the associated files.[/size]
2. Unzip the contents into your: Stardew Valley\Content\Maps.
3. Overwrite the Farm_Mining.xnb file.

[b]PLEASE BE SURE TO BACKUP ORIGINAL FILES BEFORE OVERWRITING.

[/b]
